questions.cardText:
[Ecology] What is the term for the variety of life on Earth, including plants, animals, and microorganisms?
A. Ecosystem
B. Biodiversity
C. Ecological footprint
Answer: B.
questions.en: What is the term for the variety of life on Earth, including plants, animals, and microorganisms?
questions.de: Wie lautet der Begriff für die Vielfalt des Lebens auf der Erde, einschließlich Pflanzen, Tiere und Mikroorganismen?

timeline.labelEn: Walter G. Rosen introduces the word 'biodiversity' for the National Forum on BioDiversity (21–24 September 1986)
timeline.labelDe: Walter G. Rosen führt das Wort „Biodiversität“ für das National Forum on BioDiversity (21.–24. September 1986) ein

questions.cardText:
[Earth Science] What is the Mediterranean climate known for?
A. Frequent rain and snow throughout the year
B. Hot, dry summers and mild, wet winters
C. Consistent and mild temperatures year-round
Answer: B. The Mediterranean climate is also found in places like California, Chile, and parts of Australia. The key is its location near subtropical high-pressure zones, bringing sunshine and dryness in summer, and winter winds that occasionally bring rain.
questions.en: Which climate type, also found in California, Chile and parts of Australia, is known for hot, dry summers and mild, wet winters?
questions.de: Welcher Klimatyp, der auch in Kalifornien, Chile und Teilen Australiens vorkommt, ist für heiße, trockene Sommer und milde, feuchte Winter bekannt?

timeline.labelEn: Wladimir Köppen first publishes his climate classification, which describes the dry-summer (Cs) Mediterranean climate
timeline.labelDe: Wladimir Köppen veröffentlicht erstmals seine Klimaklassifikation, die das sommertrockene Mittelmeerklima (Cs) beschreibt

questions.notes: Reversed: the card's answer is a description, so the question gives it and asks for the climate type. Timeline date from the Köppen climate classification article.
